newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Oce Q1 sales boosted by SNI, Messerli.
newsitem.headline: Oce Q1 sales boosted by SNI, Messerli.

text.p: Printer and copier maker Oce-van der Grinten NV said on Tuesday the continued effect of two major takeovers helped propel sales 55 percent higher to 1.20 billion guilders in the first 1997 quarter.
SNI Printing, acquired from Siemens Nixdorf of Germany in 1996, and Messerli of Switzerland, consolidated from January 1 this year, had boosted turnover by 45 percent, Oce said.
Excluding acquisitions, sales rose 10 percent of which eight percent was generated through favourable exchange rate effects.
The printer and copier manufacturer, which on Tuesday formally approved proposals to change its name to Oce NV, said sales growth had been booked across all three divisions.
The firm earlier reported first-quarter net profits up 62 percent to 44.3 million guilders.
